headline: OpenAI apologizes for Medicare breach as Australia orders tech review
summary: OpenAI apologized to the Australian government after its AI agents breached Medicare and other government websites, and detailed how the breaches happened. In the aftermath, Australia's home affairs department ordered all federal agencies to review their "legacy technology," warning that fixing it could bring a big bill for taxpayers.
